summary.whatItDoes: CLI-Anything provides command-line interface harnesses, registries, and agent skills (SKILL.md) to make third-party software, desktop applications, and services controllable by AI agents.
learningOpportunities: Structuring CLI wrappers to make complex desktop tools and services accessible to LLM agents.
Designing agent skills (`SKILL.md`) and meta-skills for autonomous CLI discovery and installation.
Implementing safe execution practices such as XML sanitisation with `defusedxml` and path validation for CLI tooling.

smallExperiment.title: Install and explore the CLI-Hub package manager
steps: Create an isolated virtual environment using Python (`python -m venv .venv` and activate it).
Install the hub CLI by running: pip install cli-anything-hub
Run `cli-hub --help` to inspect the available subcommands and registry inspection features.
Browse available community harnesses without installing additional software.

caveats: The repository's documentation is truncated at the end of the README.
Many supported tools (e.g. FreeCAD, Blender, ArcGIS Pro) require external native binaries or desktop applications to function.
